procedure_source:
"""只读汇总十三批历史源码、回执与本地字节；跨题面批的数据文件去重计数。"""
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd()
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def read(path):return json.loads((ROOT/path).read_text())
def code(path,commit=None):return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{commit}:{path}']) if commit else (ROOT/path).read_bytes()
reports=[];problems=[];files={};input_count=answer_count=pair_count=sample_count=field_count=0
commits={1:'2a8bc7d21',2:'79fe0c992',3:'27aabcd3e',5:'ae51f71fa',6:'56772cd62',7:'7a184e698',9:'9621ffe4d',10:'607eb3892',11:'e865edce2',12:'d897af220'}
for batch in (1,2,3,5,6,7,9,10,11,12,13):
 path=f'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch{batch}.json';report=read(path);assert report['applied']
 for key,source in [('procedure_sha256','scripts/repair_gmyhf_review_findings.py'),('rules_sha256','scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py'),('common_sha256','scripts/repair_gmyhf_pending_answers.py')]:
  assert sha(code(source,commits.get(batch)))==report[key],(batch,key)
 reports.append({'phase':batch,'path':path,'sha256':sha((ROOT/path).read_bytes())})
 for group in report['problems']:
  n=group['global_number'];assert group['local']['status']=='Accepted' and group['local']['timing_audit']['status']=='passed'
  assert group['form_unchanged'] and group['file_list_unchanged']
  assert sha((ROOT/group['evidence']).read_bytes())==group['evidence_sha256']
  directory=ROOT/group['local_dataset']
  assert sha((directory/group.get('reference_file','reference.py')).read_bytes())==group['reference_sha256']==sha(group['reference_source'].encode())
  expected=dict(group['before_files'])
  for change in group['changes']:
   assert expected[change['filename']]==change['before_sha256'];expected[change['filename']]=change['after_sha256']
   input_count+=change['filename'].endswith('.in');answer_count+=change['filename'].endswith('.out')
  assert expected==group['final_files']
  for name,digest in expected.items():
   assert (n,name) not in files;files[n,name]=digest
   if name.endswith(('.in','.out')):assert sha((directory/'data'/name).read_bytes())==digest
  pair_count+=group['verified_legal_pairs']
  problems.append({'global_number':n,'phase':batch,'report':path,'scope':'本批输入/答案修复及全量回读已完成','changes':len(group['changes'])})
for phase,path,commit in [(4,'collab/gmyhf-sample-repairs.json','05e8ffb4a'),(8,'collab/gmyhf-statement-repairs-batch8.json','1aba30da1'),(9,'collab/gmyhf-statement-repairs-batch9.json','9621ffe4d'),(10,'collab/gmyhf-statement-repairs-batch10.json','607eb3892')]:
 report=read(path);assert report['applied']
 assert report['procedure_sha256']==sha(code('scripts/repair_gmyhf_sample_findings.py',commit))
 if 'recipes_sha256' in report:assert report['recipes_sha256']==sha(code('scripts/gmyhf_statement_fixes.py',commit))
 if 'reference_rules_sha256' in report:assert report['reference_rules_sha256']==sha(code('scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py',commit))
 reports.append({'phase':phase,'path':path,'sha256':sha((ROOT/path).read_bytes())})
 for group in report['problems']:
  n=group['global_number'];assert group['before_files']==group['final_files'] and group['local_matches'] and group['only_allowed_fields_changed']
  assert sha((ROOT/group['evidence']).read_bytes())==group['evidence_sha256']
  local=ROOT/group['local_statement'];fields=read(str(local.relative_to(ROOT))+'/fields.json')
  normalized={k:v.replace('\r\n','\n') for k,v in fields.items()}
  assert sha(json.dumps(normalized,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True).encode())==group['after_form_sha256']
  assert sha((local/'reference.py').read_bytes())==group['reference_sha256']
  prior={25685:'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch7.json',28277:'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch9.json',28680:'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch9.json',21729:'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch10.json'}.get(n)
  if prior:
   assert sha((ROOT/prior).read_bytes())==group['prior_repair_sha256']
   previous=next(g for g in read(prior)['problems'] if g['global_number']==n)
   assert group['final_files']==previous['final_files']
  for name,digest in group['final_files'].items():
   if (n,name) in files:assert files[n,name]==digest and prior
   files[n,name]=digest
  sample_count+=len(group['samples']);field_count+=len(group['changed_fields'])
  problems.append({'global_number':n,'phase':phase,'report':path,'scope':'本批题面/样例修复及全量回读已完成','changed_fields':sorted(group['changed_fields'])})
proof=read('collab/gmyhf-31241-small-proof.json');assert proof['all_matched'] and proof['cases']==388
assert proof['reference_sha256']==next(g for g in read('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch12.json')['problems'] if g['global_number']==31241)['reference_sha256']
proof13=read('collab/gmyhf-31239-small-proof.json');assert proof13['all_matched'] and proof13['cases']==654
assert proof13['reference_sha256']==next(g for g in read('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch13.json')['problems'] if g['global_number']==31239)['reference_sha256']
certificate=read('collab/gmyhf-30549-certificate-recheck.json');assert certificate['certificate_pairs']==101 and len(certificate['readback_files'])==202 and certificate['platform_writes']==0
assert all(r['independent_valid'] for r in certificate['checks']+certificate['samples'])
step_findings=[]
group=next(g for g in read('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch5.json')['problems'] if g['global_number']==28682)
for row in next(e for e in read(group['evidence'])['entries'] if e['global_number']==28682)['checks']['answers']['files']:
 before=(ROOT/f'data/openjudge/tests/admin_download/28682/{row["input"]}').read_bytes()
 tokens=before.split();n,m=map(int,tokens[:2]);steps=[int(tokens[3+2*n+2*i]) for i in range(m)]
 if n in steps:
  after=(ROOT/group['local_dataset']/'data'/row['input']).read_bytes();fixed=after.split()
  assert sha(before)==row['input_sha256'] and sha(after)==group['final_files'][row['input']]
  assert all(1<=int(fixed[3+2*n+2*i])<n for i in range(m))
  step_findings.append({'input':row['input'],'before_sha256':sha(before),'after_sha256':sha(after),'original_steps_equal_n':steps.count(n),'corrected_steps_strictly_less_than_n':True})
assert len(step_findings)==10
mutations=[]
for path in ['collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch2-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch3-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-sample-repairs-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch5-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch6-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch7-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-statement-repairs-batch8-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch9-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch10-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch11-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch12-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch13-mutations.json','collab/gmyhf-30549-recheck-mutations.json']:
 report=read(path);assert all(row['detected'] for row in report['results'])
 mutations.append({'path':path,'sha256':sha((ROOT/path).read_bytes()),'detected':len(report['results'])})
assert len({g['global_number'] for g in problems})==40
result={'scope':'T-060十三批指定问题的修复收口；不是所有历史疑点已消除或已接入题库的声明。',
 'totals':{'problems':len({g['global_number'] for g in problems}),'repaired_inputs':input_count,'repaired_answers':answer_count,'changed_statement_fields':field_count,'accepted_legal_pairs':pair_count,'recomputed_samples':sample_count,'readback_files':len(files),'detected_mutations':sum(m['detected'] for m in mutations)},
 'reports':reports,'problems':sorted(problems,key=lambda g:(g['global_number'],g['phase'])),'mutations':mutations,
 'additional_finding':{'global_number':28682,'rule':'1≤s_i<n；原第13批未单列10份s_i=n，现改为n−1。','files':step_findings},
 'reference_validation':{'path':'collab/gmyhf-31241-small-proof.json','sha256':sha((ROOT/'collab/gmyhf-31241-small-proof.json').read_bytes()),'cases':388},
 'reference_validation13':{'path':'collab/gmyhf-31239-small-proof.json','sha256':sha((ROOT/'collab/gmyhf-31239-small-proof.json').read_bytes()),'cases':654},
 'certificate_recheck':{'path':'collab/gmyhf-30549-certificate-recheck.json','sha256':sha((ROOT/'collab/gmyhf-30549-certificate-recheck.json').read_bytes()),'pairs':101,'samples':2,'readback_files':202,'platform_writes':0,'counted_separately_from_repaired_problems':True},
 'display_recheck':{'path':'collab/gmyhf-30686-display-recheck.json','sha256':sha((ROOT/'collab/gmyhf-30686-display-recheck.json').read_bytes()),'platform_writes':0},
 'next_candidates_not_exhaustive':[27934,27952,28341,29663,30686],
 'preserved_exclusions':'未放宽valid、时限余量、2MiB输出或SPJ要求；无公开映射和无下载题仍保留原排除。',
 'procedure_sha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),'procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(ROOT/'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result['totals'],ensure_ascii=False))
